# Modern Azure Bicep Best Practices Plugin ### Enterprise Infrastructure as Code Engineering & Azure Architecture Standards [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Professional modern Azure Bicep engineering best practices covering modular architecture & AVM, User-Defined Types (UDT) and .bicepparam parameter files, zero-secrets security & Managed Identity RBAC, Container Apps & Jobs microservice topologies, Cosmos DB MongoDB API autoscale throughput governance, API Management external VNet & XML policies (rate limiting, Entra ID JWT, RFC 6648 idempotency), Azure Monitor Workbooks & FinOps telemetry, Azure Deployment Stacks lifecycle & drift governance, multi-gate CI/CD with OIDC, PSRule/linter validation, and mandatory living README.md runbook documentation discipline.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-azure-bicep-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-azure-bicep-best-practices ``` --- ## Overview Modern cloud engineering demands infrastructure as code that is deterministic, type-safe, drift-resistant, and free of secret leakages. Without strict architectural discipline, Azure infrastructure codebases frequently suffer from critical enterprise failure modes: - **The Legacy JSON Parameters Trap**: Maintaining verbose, brittle `parameters.json` files that lack compile-time validation, type checking, or environment variable resolution. - **Untyped "God" Objects**: Passing untyped `object` and `array` configurations to modules, hiding schema requirements and deferring syntax errors to runtime deployment crashes. - **Secret & Connection String Sprawl**: Baking database passwords, storage keys, and connection strings into Bicep templates or deployment state rather than using Managed Identities and Azure RBAC. - **Microservice Perimeter Leaks & Idle Compute**: Exposing internal container apps directly to public ingress or running continuous background services for workloads that should scale to zero as ephemeral scheduled jobs. - **Uncontrolled Cloud Database Spending**: Over-provisioning static database throughput or neglecting to set declarative autoscale caps on collections created by migration scripts. - **Gateway Policy Sprawl & Starvation**: Hardcoding XML policies without dynamic caller identity or failing to bypass health probe endpoints from rate limiting and authentication checks. - **Orphaned Resources & Cost Leaks**: Running loose ARM deployments (`az deployment group create`) that fail to clean up deleted resources, leaving costly orphaned disks, VMs, and subnets running indefinitely. - **Out-of-Band Cloud Drift**: Allowing operators or automated scripts to mutate cloud resources directly, drifting away from source control definitions. - **Long-Lived CI/CD Credentials**: Storing static service principal passwords in CI/CD secret stores, creating major supply-chain exposure risks. This plugin establishes modern, production-grade engineering standards for Azure Bicep across eight comprehensive pillars: 1. **Modular Architecture & Contracts (`modern-bicep-modular-architecture`)**: Azure Verified Modules (AVM) compliance, compile-time type safety with User-Defined Types (`type`), User-Defined Functions (`func`), native `.bicepparam` parameter files, registry distribution (Public MCR and Private ACR), and cross-scope orchestration. 2. **Security, Identity & Governance (`modern-bicep-security-and-governance`)**: Zero secrets in source code, `@secure()` decorator rules, Azure RBAC authorization over legacy access policies, User-Assigned Managed Identity lifecycles, deterministic role assignment GUIDs with `guid()`, network isolation with Private Endpoints, and Customer-Managed Keys (CMK). 3. **Container Apps & Ephemeral Jobs (`modern-bicep-container-apps-and-jobs`)**: Microservice compute topology segregation, internal CAE ingress with `ipSecurityRestrictions` allowing APIM subnet only, background ShedLock worker isolation, scheduled cron jobs (`Microsoft.App/jobs`), manual migration jobs, scale-to-zero mock servers, and dynamic `secretRef` Key Vault resolution. 4. **Cosmos DB & Data Governance (`modern-bicep-cosmos-db`)**: MongoDB API 7.0 specification, session consistency, decoupled collection-level autoscale throughput settings (`throughputSettings` RU/s), periodic vs continuous 30-day backup policies, private DNS wiring (`privatelink.mongo.cosmos.azure.com`), and secure connection string export via `@secure()`. 5. **API Management & XML Policies (`modern-bicep-api-management-and-policies`)**: External VNet injection, internal ACA backends, Products, APIs, typed Operations, W3C distributed tracing diagnostics, route-based rate limiting (``), Entra ID OAuth 2.0 JWT validation (``), RFC 6648 idempotency validation & response caching, URI rewrites, and probe bypassing. 6. **Workbooks & Observability (`modern-bicep-workbooks-and-observability`)**: Azure Monitor Workbooks (`Microsoft.Insights/workbooks`), mandatory deterministic GUID resource naming via `guid()`, declarative `serializedData` dashboard composition, cold-start resilient hybrid KQL queries (`union isfuzzy=true`), RED metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration), and FinOps unit economics (RU/s per 1,000 transactions). 7. **Deployment Stacks & Lifecycle Governance (`modern-bicep-deployment-stacks-and-lifecycle`)**: Treating infrastructure as an atomic unit using **Azure Deployment Stacks**, enforcing drift protection via Deny Assignments (`denyWriteAndDelete`), automated resource cleanup with `actionOnUnmanage`, What-If pre-flight verification, and dependency DAG optimization. 8. **Testing, Quality Gates & CI/CD Pipelines (`modern-bicep-testing-and-ci-cd`)**: Shift-left multi-gate validation, Bicep linter enforcement (`bicepconfig.json`), static analysis against the Microsoft Well-Architected Framework using PSRule for Azure, passwordless OIDC Workload Identity Federation in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps, PR What-If diff commenting, and the mandatory living `README.md` runbook mandate. XML Policy Engine in Bicep: external VNet injection, internal Container Apps backends, Products, APIs, typed Operations, W3C distributed tracing (App Insights loggers & diagnostics), and XML policies: route-based rate limiting (), Entra ID OAuth JWT validation (), RFC 6648 idempotency validation & response caching (/), backend timeouts (), URI rewrites, and health probe bypassing. - ('MongoDB'), server version 7.0, session consistency, autoscale collection throughput settings (throughputSettings RU/s) decoupled from collection provisioning, periodic vs continuous backup policies, private endpoints with privatelink.mongo.cosmos.azure.com DNS, and secure connection string export via @secure() and listConnectionStrings(). - **[`/modern-bicep-deployment-stacks-and-lifecycle`](skills/modern-bicep-deployment-stacks-and-lifecycle/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when managing cloud infrastructure lifecycles and governance with Azure Deployment Stacks: atomic stack lifecycle management, drift & tampering prevention with Deny Settings (denyWriteAndDelete, denyWrite), orphaned resource elimination with Action on Unmanage (delete vs detach), What-If pre-flight validation, multi-scope orchestration (Management Group, Subscription, Resource Group), and dependency graph optimization. - **[`/modern-bicep-modular-architecture`](skills/modern-bicep-modular-architecture/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when designing, authoring, or refactoring modular Azure Bicep codebases: Azure Verified Modules (AVM) compliance, User-Defined Types (UDT with type keyword), User-Defined Functions (func keyword), native .bicepparam parameter files, private/public Bicep Registries (ACR/MCR), multi-scope deployments (Tenant, Management Group, Subscription, Resource Group), child/extension resources, and deterministic loops. - **[`/modern-bicep-security-and-governance`](skills/modern-bicep-security-and-governance/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when implementing security, identity, access control, and compliance in Azure Bicep: zero plain-text secrets, @secure() decorator discipline, Azure Key Vault integration, Managed Identities (User-Assigned & System-Assigned), granular RBAC with deterministic guid() role assignments, network isolation (Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, disabling public network access), Customer-Managed Keys (CMK), and Azure Policy as Code. - **[`/modern-bicep-testing-and-ci-cd`](skills/modern-bicep-testing-and-ci-cd/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when implementing automated validation, testing, and CI/CD pipelines for Azure Bicep: bicepconfig.json linter enforcement, PSRule for Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF) static analysis, passwordless OIDC Workload Identity Federation (GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps), automated PR What-If diff commenting, and the mandatory living README.md runbook documentation discipline. -
